name: Punjab Kissan Support
summary: Smallholder subsidy for fertilizer and seeds in Punjab.
steps: Check eligibility: land ownership or tenancy documents.
Gather CNIC and farm registration documents.
Visit the local agriculture extension office or designated portal.
Fill the subsidy application form and attach required documents.
Submit application and keep the submission receipt number.
Follow up with the extension office for approval and disbursement steps.

name: National Kissan Package
summary: Federal-level assistance for mechanization and training.
steps: Review program eligibility on the official ministry website.
Prepare CNIC, proof of residence, and farm details.
Apply online via the ministry portal or through field offices.
Attend mandatory training sessions if required.
Receive confirmation and scheduled assistance delivery.
